title: phlegmariurus terrae-guilelmi
intro: Phlegmariurus terrae-guilelmi, commonly known as the "Guinea Gold Tree", is a species of flowering plant in the lycopodiophyta class, which belongs to the lycopodiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phlegmariurus terrae-guilelmi include reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
